Arcade Classic No. 3 - Galaga & Galaxian.name: Arcade Classic No. 3: Galaga / Galaxian
Arcade Classic No. 3 - Galaga & Galaxian.summary: A compilation of two classic arcade titles, Galaga and Galaxian ported over to the Game Boy and features original gameplay features. It is also Super Game Boy compatible complete with background borders that replicate their original arcade machine casings.

Battletoads.name: Battletoads
Battletoads.summary: Battletoads for the Game Boy (not to be confused with Battletoads in Ragnarok's World, which is a port of the NES game) is the second game in the Battletoads series.

Beavis and Butt-head.name: MTV's Beavis and Butt-head
Beavis and Butt-head.summary: Game Boy Port of MTV's Beavis and Butt-head.

Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle, The.name: The Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle
Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle, The.summary:
The Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle for the Game Boy is a port of the game called Mickey Mouse, which is, in turn, a port of the Famicom Disk System game Roger Rabbit (known in the West as The Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle, NES version).
It is a portable port of the first Crazy Castle game.

Heiankyo Alien.name: Heiankyo Alien
Heiankyo Alien.summary: Heiankyo Alien takes place during the Heian Age when the city of Kyo is invaded by aliens. The aliens have been eating the people and devouring the city. As a Kebiishi, or knight, you decide to defend the city by burying the aliens alive. Your task is to run around areas set up like mazes and dig holes. The longer you hold down the button the larger the hole will be. Holes need to be placed strategically so as to trap the moving aliens and not to corner yourself. When an alien falls into a hole you must then refill the hole before they can escape. Defeat all 12 rounds to win the game. Play alone, against a friend, or team up with a friend to bury aliens alive in Heiankyo Alien.

Legend of the River King GB.name: Legend of the River King GB
Legend of the River King GB.summary: You'll need all your angling and survival skills to succeed in this unique fishing RPG. On a perilous quest to capture a mysterious and mystical fish, you'll deploy a variety of tackle in both quiet lakes and raging rapids. Along the shores, dangerous animals are a constant threat. To get supplies, you'll sell some of your catch at village markets. You can also try your hand at raising a pet fish from embryo to adult and watch as it grows and even changes species!
